title: Draw icons
description: Three or four line icons draw themselves stroke by stroke (anime.js svg.createDrawable), and a label rises under each. Built-in icons: camera, slides, browser, cube, book, mic.

props.items: required, 3-4 items: {icon, title, text}; icon = camera, slides, browser, cube, book or mic
props.title: heading
props.click: true = one icon per click on a slide

example.title: A free live class, weeknights at 8 PM
